cases.refreshed: Do you need help using a computer? Want to set up an email account? Stop by the Santa Teresa Branch Library for a session with our experienced volunteer! They can help you set up an email account, write and send emails, use attachments, search the web, and enter data. They can also help you learn the basics of Microsoft Word, Excel, or web tools such as Google Docs, use the library's pay-for-print and photocopy machines, or download apps on your phone or tablet. events.title: Bilingual Toddler Storytime / Tiempo de Cuentos & Stay and Play

cases.refreshed: Bilingual Toddler Storytime is designed for toddlers to engage in early literacy activities such as stories, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement. While the program is geared toward children ages 1–3, all children ages 0–5 are welcome to attend. After Storytime concludes, families are invited to Stay & Play. For 30 minutes following Storytime, special age-appropriate toys will be available for children and caregivers to continue the fun together: Storytime: 11:30 a.m. to noon; Stay & Play: noon to 12:30 p.m. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards. Tiempo de Cuentos & Stay and Play: Tiempo de Cuentos está diseñado para niños pequeños e invita a toda la familia a participar en actividades de alfabetización temprana, como cuentos, rimas, juegos con los dedos y actividades de movimiento. Después de que concluya el Tiempo de Cuentos, las familias están invitadas a quedarse y jugar. Durante 30 minutos después del Tiempo de Cuentos, habrá juguetes especiales y apropiados para cada edad disponibles para continuar la diversión. Tiempo de cuentos: 11:30 a.m. - 12:00 p.m.; Stay & Play: 12:00 p.m. - 12:30 p.m. Este programa ha sido diseñado en alineación con los Estándares de Calidad de la Educación Infantil.

events.title: Asistencia para buscar trabajo y crear un resumen (currículum)

cases.refreshed: ¿Necesita ayuda con su currículum o para buscar oportunidades de empleo? Reúnase personalmente con un miembro del personal de la biblioteca (uno a uno) para aprender cómo: Crear o actualizar su currículum; Navegar por sitios web de solicitudes de empleo; Completar formularios de solicitud de empleo; Aprender técnicas de entrevista; Obtener ayuda para registrarse en ServSafe (tarjeta para manipuladores de alimentos); *Desafortunadamente, no podemos ayudar con ninguna información personal/sensible (por ejemplo, número de seguro social, información bancaria, formularios de impuestos, etc.). Para registrarse, llame al (408) 294-1237.

events.title: Adult Book Discussion: True Grit by Charles Portis

cases.refreshed: In December, the Cupertino Library Adult Book Discussion Group will discuss the novel True Grit by Charles Portis (1968). Mattie Ross knows that as a teenaged girl in the 1870's, she'll need help finding Tom Chaney, her late father's murderer. Especially since Chaney is a member of a notorious outlaw gang. She hires the washed up Marshall Rueben T. "Rooster" Cogburn, believing he has the true grit necessary for the dangerous job, and that his reputation for violence is an asset in the circumstances. He agrees to help out of a desperate need for money. A Texas ranger joins forces with them since he's also seeking Chaney for a previous murder and he's intent on bringing him back to Texas to earn the "dead or alive" reward. Despite their different motivations, the three of them are a team by the time they finally track Chaney and the gang down. The Adult Book Discussion Group meets twice a month, on the third Wednesday morning at 11 AM, and the third Thursday evening at 7 PM. All meetings are held in Room 201B. All meetings are sponsored by The Friends of the Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
